overview: 19 Studio is a professional hair salon booking website where clients can browse services, choose a stylist, pick available time slots, and confirm appointments online. Studio admins can manage all bookings from a protected dashboard.
features: Service selection with pricing (Haircut, Color, Blowout, Consultation)
Interactive calendar with available time slots
Client booking form with name, email, and phone
Protected admin dashboard to manage all appointments
Admin ability to cancel or complete bookings
